scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-setup.mjs && pnpm run generate:service-wiring && node scripts/local-runtime-cleanup.mjs && scripts/local-pm2.sh start ecosystem.local.config.cjs && scripts/local-pm2.sh logs fa-chat-service fa-knowledge-service fa-llm-usage-service fa-user-service fa-web
scripts.services:start: node scripts/dev-setup.mjs && node scripts/local-runtime-cleanup.mjs && scripts/local-pm2.sh start ecosystem.local.config.cjs
scripts.services:stop: scripts/local-pm2.sh stop fa-chat-service fa-knowledge-service fa-llm-usage-service fa-user-service fa-web && node scripts/local-runtime-cleanup.mjs
scripts.services:delete: scripts/local-pm2.sh delete fa-chat-service fa-knowledge-service fa-llm-usage-service fa-user-service fa-web && node scripts/local-runtime-cleanup.mjs
scripts.services:logs: scripts/local-pm2.sh logs fa-chat-service fa-knowledge-service fa-llm-usage-service fa-user-service fa-web
scripts.services:restart: node scripts/dev-setup.mjs && node scripts/local-runtime-cleanup.mjs && scripts/local-pm2.sh startOrReload ecosystem.local.config.cjs --update-env
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:service-wiring && pnpm run verify:env && pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/verify-data-baseline.test.ts && pnpm run verify:knowledge-access && pnpm run verify:static && pnpm run verify:observability
scripts.test:observability: node --test scripts/observability/*.test.mjs && pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/verify-observability.test.ts
scripts.build:prod: pnpm run build:services && pnpm run build:web
scripts.ci:prod:extras: pnpm run verify:shell && pnpm run verify:terraform && pnpm run build:prod && pnpm run verify:prod-runtime
scripts.ci:prod: pnpm run ci && pnpm run ci:prod:extras
